verdict.line: You lose if Riven dumps a full Q-W-E combo into you before your Grit shield is ready; you win if you land Facebreaker while her Q and E are both on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Riven's whole kit is three Q (Broken Wings) dash charges plus an E (Valor) dash that blocks damage and resets her spacing — Sett has zero mobility, so every trade is decided by whether he can time E (Facebreaker) for the window after she's spent those dashes. Sett's W (Haymaker) banks every point of damage he eats as Grit, so tanking her poke instead of dodging it is correct play, not just survival. OP.GG's 50.9% win rate over 1,564 games and the even solo-kill rate both read as a lane that rewards patience over flashy all-ins.

theirWindow.when: she has full Q-W-E and you're Grit-empty
theirWindow.what: She can chain Q (Broken Wings) in, W (Ki Burst) to stun, finish the Q sequence for the knockback, then E (Valor) to disengage — a full burst-and-reset combo. If you haven't banked Grit for W's shield, disengage or trade with autos only.

yourWindow.when: after she's used Q and E recently
yourWindow.what: Broken Wings is on a 13s cooldown and Valor is 10/9/8/7/6s — once both are spent she has no dash left to dodge or escape. Walk up and land E (Facebreaker) for the stun, then Q (Knuckle Down) and autos.

start.why: 80% pick, 43.8% win rate over 16 games. The lifesteal and health pad let you tank her Q poke for Grit instead of backing off, feeding your W shield.

boots.why: 80% pick, 43.8% win rate over 16 games. Flat physical reduction blunts her Runic Blade-empowered autos and the burst window when she dumps Q-W-E.

core.why: Gives you the slow-on-hit you need once Facebreaker lands, so she can't just E (Valor) away after the stun breaks.
Armor shred keeps your autos and Q (Knuckle Down) true-damage-adjacent burst relevant as she stacks resistances.
Health plus the burn punishes her for staying in extended trades instead of hit-and-run poke.

situational.when: she is landing her full Q-W-E combo on you consistently and you need the tenacity and shield to survive it
the lane stabilizes and you want faster Q/E/W cooldowns to out-trade her over a longer fight
she is sustaining through your trades off Conqueror stacks or lifesteal
she is kiting you with repeated Valor dashes and Plated Steelcaps isn't letting you stick

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained trades are your path to winning this lane — Conqueror's healing matches the exact stack-and-tank pattern Sett wants, and OP.GG's own tip to track her Conqueror stacks means she's running the same ramp, so don't disengage her stacking window just because you're taking damage.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the most-run combo in this matchup (50% pick). Since Facebreaker only lands reliably once her Q and E are down, Ignite converts that window into a kill instead of just a shove.

playing.title: Trade with autos until Grit is full
playing.detail: Don't force W (Haymaker) early — let her poke you with Q (Broken Wings) and bank the Grit, then punch back once the shield and true damage are worth it.

playing.title: Hold E until her dashes are spent
playing.detail: Facebreaker whiffs or gets dodged if she still has a Q charge or Valor up. Wait for her to commit at least one before pulling.

playing.title: Pop W right after she all-ins
playing.detail: A full Q-W-E combo from her maxes your stored Grit — immediately Haymaker for the true-damage center hit and shield to flip the trade.

playing.title: Respect level 6-10 kill pressure
playing.detail: The Show Stopper gives you a hard engage she has no dash to escape cleanly; look for it the moment she overextends post-combo.

playing.title: Watch her R timer after level 11
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile drops to a 10s cooldown at rank 5 (available from level 16), giving her repeated Wind Slash poke — don't facecheck brush once she's near max level.

playing.title: Don't dodge, tank
playing.detail: Sidestepping her poke denies your own W stacks. Walking into her autos and Q hits is correct as long as you're using your sustain to win the extended trade, not just survive it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win/pick-rate numbers above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the ability timings, trade windows, and cooldown-based tactical reading are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Check Riven’s Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Use your abilities whenever the come off cooldown to deal damage. Use your lane sustain to gain control over lane.
